prerequisites: Basic mathematical skills: trigonometry, elementary geometry, simple functions, their derivatives and integrals.

learning_outcomes.text: To learn the laws of classical physics at an elementary level.
understand the description of simple physics problems
apply the knowledge of the laws of physics to address the solution of these problems
make judgements on the relevant approximations
obtain the solutions by means of simple mathematical calculations.

assessment_methods.method: Two written papers during the course

assessment_rules: The exam may be passed following two routes. The suggested route consists of two written papers during the course, plus an oral examination (optional or compulsory based on paper marks). If no paper is failed and the average mark is at least 21/30, these marks can be directly registered. Up to 2/30 points can be additionally obtained from completing 88 online problems. Alternatively, a single final paper plus an oral exam can be taken in one of the seven available sessions. All exams, written and oral, involve solving problems similar to those discussed in tutorials.
